name: Hishida Shunsou
source:
Occupation: Art student (specifically, Japanese-style painting art student).

Art student who recently moved to Tokyo from Nagano, Shinshu.
Taciturn and cool character. Midway through, he was half-coerced to stay at the Mori home on the invitation of Ougai.
However, when he finds someone he wants to paint, he has the odd habit of hitting on that person, regardless of who they are. He is unaware of this trait in himself.
